question: Oddzielenie regularności od kompletności oznaczeń i porównanie motywu1–3pozycji

protocol.question: Czy rozdzielenie regularności pozycji i kompletności oznaczeń oraz model 1–3 powtarzalnych pozycji poprawia przewidywania nowych otoczeń bez wzrostu pozornego porządku?
protocol.candidate_bases: Unchanged basis_candidates.candidates with peaks+divisors; all valid candidates, no truth/validation proposal.
protocol.training: K1 previous five-iteration Huber2 fit. K2/3 deterministic toroidal KDE seeds then six joint weighted least-squares iterations, Huber2, affine correction spectral norm<=15% relative to proposal. Every motif site needs>=3 distinct training cells, sites>=3px apart. Canonical basis and motif phases; no refit after validation.
protocol.position_score: S=mean(log(0.1+0.9*abs(det B)/(K*2*pi*2^2)*sum exp(-distance^2/(2*2^2)))). Periodic Gaussian sum using5x5 indices aroundroundedcoordinate. This is a cell-density normalized periodic contrast, NOT a finite-window conditional likelihood or p-value. Finite clipped ring may introduce boundary effects; empirical negative calibration only.
protocol.selection: baseline: max validation soft F among K1. position1: max validation S among K1. motif: max validation [S-(K-1)*log(Nval)/Nval] amongK1..3. Fixed heuristic complexity cost, not BIC; ties1e-10 favor smallerK then deterministic candidate order. No test-based fallback.
protocol.completeness: Separate soft one-to-one matched mass/Npredicted nodes. Not known annotation recall, physical occupancy or material coverage. Also report matched mass/Nobserved and old symmetric F.
protocol.new_rows: Whole indexlevel of cell is outside discovery .75R for ALL motif site planes, same side of center. Disjoint sectors by minperpendicular distance overmotifsites, largeraxis wins. Eachaxis>=2 distinct indexlevels containing>=2 distinct cells,>=4centers and>=4nodes. Motifsites within samecell do not countasnewrepeats. No availability means unknown.
protocol.calibration: 19 earlier unique negative geometries, q99 perarm/global ornewrows. >=100available windows and>=3geometries, otherwise unknown. Common threshold ONLY position1 vs motif (sameunits), maximumtwofrozen thresholds. BaselineF differsunits. Calibrationfixedbeforefresh/TT.
protocol.reference_policy: 24fullTT frames, references only aftermeasurementlock;18partial reference frames+6without. Pure>=80% centers inoneregion beforemixed>=20% eachoftwo. Unknownoutside labels. No domain count or reference labels in inference.
protocol.evaluation: Known synthetic predictions compare full imagecenters independently of missingannotations, not K alone (equivalent supercell representations possible). All-missing-columns ambiguity explicit. Compare missingness separately from actual jitter4px disorder and independentrow phases. Test materialgap vs annotationgap geometryidentical.
protocol.success: Improved heldout regularity/recovery of incomplete and multisite controls, no rise in falsepositive random/disordered/independentrows; fullTT confirmation same frozenprotocol. Increaseinacceptedwindowsalone insufficient; no production selection.
protocol.scope: Localrepeatdiagnostic only, no domaincomponents/boundaries/coverage, no training/GPU. R64only dueindependentrepeatavailability; not fullscaleanalysis. Temporaladjacency/overlappingwindows and reusedTTrefs preclude independentgeneralizationclaim.
protocol.new_rows_gauge: Anchor is mean of training centers; motif offsets folded into cell relative to anchor. Conservative whole-cell new-row availability depends on this cell partition even for equivalent node sets. Oracle uses identical training anchor; unavailable is not physical disorder.

evaluation.interior_subgroup: Geometric diagnostic declared before evaluation: entire radius64 disk contained within image bounds and all pixel centers in disk measured. Fresh summaries include all plus interior; TTMAPP pure/mixed/unknown rules unchanged. On192x192 grid12+24n there are4 interior windows per image,12 per three-seed case. No acceptance, model or threshold changes.
evaluation.common_threshold_diagnostic: Maximum already-frozen negative threshold only between position1 and motif, separately for global/new rows. Baseline F has different units and uses its own threshold.
evaluation.motif_count_not_accuracy: No K-correct metric: equivalent cell representations may contain different numbers of sites.
evaluation.prediction_evaluation: Maximum one-to-one matches at distance<=2px and soft F on full image centers in held-out annulus; truth never used to fit/select. Repeated overlapping windows are not independent.
evaluation.oracle_evaluation: Known generator model evaluated only after inference lock; new-row availability is reported separately from fit quality and annotation availability. No oracle-based model selection or thresholds.
evaluation.oracle_gauge_limit: Oracle anchor is the mean of training centers, as in fitting; whole-cell-plane availability can depend on the chosen equivalent cell representation and offset wrapping even for identical predicted node sets.
evaluation.physical_disorder_control: disorder and motif2_disorder physically displace image molecules by sigma4px; they probe degradation, not a guarantee that all residual periodic information is absent.
evaluation.hidden_annotation_limit: all_missing_columns reports physical image prediction and separately observed-only prediction. Hidden regular deletions are unidentifiable from supplied centers; no recovery claim.
evaluation.hidden_annotation_flag: False only for the explicit all_missing_columns non-identifiability control; null means not assessed, not a claim that other hidden annotations are identifiable.

numerical_audit.note: Checks concern numerical implementation, not domain detection accuracy. The periodic contrast is not a finite-window normalized likelihood.

results_audit.inference: The additional motif model improves prediction of two-site controls, but creates new accepted independent-row controls and does not change accepted TTMAPP windows. The predefined overall success criterion is not met.

blind_replay.duration_note: Sum of separate stage wall times, not total wall time; a previous interrupted full replay is excluded.

verdict: Pozycje oddzielone od kompletności pomagają przy brakach; model par poprawia geometrię, ale dodaje fałszywe akceptacje rzędów. Rozszerzony motyw nie poprawia TTMAPP; nie spełniono całościowego kryterium sukcesu.
